name: KHORASHADIZADEH, Ali; GHORBANIYAN, Mohammad
why_famous: Treasury's first publication of digital currency identifiers named two Iran-based financial facilitators in the SamSam ransomware case.
notes: Two named individuals form one historical case; this row is not an entity count.

name: EVIL CORP
chains: No digital currency identifiers in this action
why_famous: Treasury designated the Dridex-linked cybercriminal group in an early ransomware sanctions action.
notes: Context case: the saved 2019 Recent Actions page contains no digital currency identifier; do not create an on-chain sample from vendor attribution.

name: SUEX OTC, S.R.O.
why_famous: Treasury described this as its first sanctions designation of a virtual currency exchange.
notes: USDT identifiers are Bitcoin-format; ticker USDT alone does not establish Tron or Ethereum. Chainalysis post is dated the next day.

name: CHATEX
chains: Bitcoin; Ethereum; XRP Ledger; USDT network unresolved
why_famous: Treasury sanctioned the Telegram-based virtual currency exchange and its support network in a ransomware action.
notes: USDT is an asset ticker, not a chain; Bitcoin-format USDT identifiers require separate network resolution.

name: HYDRA MARKET
why_famous: The designation coincided with the German seizure of the major Russia-based darknet market.
notes: Concurrent seizure is a confounder for a sanctions-only interpretation.

name: GARANTEX EUROPE OU
chains: Bitcoin; Ethereum; Tron (2025 addition); USDT network unresolved
why_famous: The sanctioned exchange continued operating and Treasury later designated its identified successor Grinex.
notes: March 2025 disruption is described in the August Treasury release; do not equate the initial 2022 listed addresses with the vendor's entire exchange cluster.

name: LAZARUS GROUP
why_famous: OFAC added the Ethereum identifier associated with the Ronin bridge theft to Lazarus Group's existing entry.
notes: The primary date is an address addition, not Lazarus Group's original designation. No same-day Treasury release is linked on the 2022 page; the May 6 Blender release explicitly recalls the April 14 addition.

name: BLENDER.IO
why_famous: Treasury called Blender.io its first-ever sanctions designation of a virtual currency mixer.
notes: A vendor's suggestion that Sinbad was a rebrand is an attributed hypothesis; it is not a new ownership inference by this project.

name: TORNADO CASH
chains: Ethereum (listed identifiers); other deployments outside this case scope
why_famous: The sanctions on the decentralized mixing protocol prompted extensive research and litigation before Treasury delisted it.
notes: Removal plus re-designation on 2022-11-08 is not a sanctions-free interval. Do not label post-2025-03-21 protocol use as post-designation sanctioned activity without a separate then-current basis.

name: SINBAD
why_famous: Treasury designated the Bitcoin mixer citing its role in processing virtual currency stolen by Lazarus Group.
notes: OFAC's primary name is SINBAD; SINBAD.IO is an alias. A coordinated seizure also affected operations.

name: WANG, Hongfei
why_famous: Treasury published a Bitcoin identifier in an action against Chinese fentanyl-precursor suppliers connected to Mexican drug production.
notes: Treasury states the named connection to Wuhan Shuokang Biological Technology and fentanyl precursors; do not infer identities of unlabelled counterparties.

name: CRYPTEX
why_famous: The exchange designation formed part of a coordinated action against Russian virtual currency services and a payment facilitator.
notes: PM2BTC was subject to a concurrent FinCEN section 9714 measure, not an OFAC designation in this action. Ivanov was designated with UAPS as an alias; do not turn the service itself into a separate SDN.

name: KONDRATIEV, Ivan Gennadievich; SUNGATOV, Artur Ravilevich
why_famous: Treasury named LockBit affiliates during the international disruption of the ransomware operation.
notes: Vendor posts cover the May 2024 leader action and provide broader LockBit context; TRM's cluster totals exceed the set of explicitly listed identifiers.

name: ZSERVERS
why_famous: Treasury targeted bulletproof hosting infrastructure, with a later related policy action against Aeza Group.
notes: These are separate hosting providers grouped as one editorial case family, not a claim of shared control; program labels are those at their respective actions.

name: FUNNULL TECHNOLOGY INC
why_famous: Treasury sanctioned a technology provider it identified as infrastructure for virtual currency investment scams.
notes: The two identifiers are for the provider; their inflows are not automatically the total loss of scam victims.

name: ANDREYEV, Vitaliy Sergeyevich
why_famous: The action illustrates Treasury's use of crypto identifiers against facilitators of DPRK IT-worker revenue schemes.
notes: The 2025 and 2026 targets are distinct networks grouped by published scheme type; do not infer a direct connection. The 2026 page also updates Sim Hyon Sop's pre-existing entry.

name: KAREN NATIONAL ARMY
chains: No digital currency identifiers in this action
why_famous: Treasury linked the Burma militia and named leaders to cyber-scam operations, human trafficking and cross-border smuggling.
notes: Context case requested by the job; no digital currency identifiers occur in the saved action. No case-specific vendor post verified in this review; do not fabricate an address cohort.

name: CHEN, Zhi; PRINCE GROUP TRANSNATIONAL CRIMINAL ORGANIZATION
why_famous: The coordinated action targeted the Prince Group scam network alongside a separate FinCEN measure against Huione Group.
notes: The listed Bitcoin identifiers are attached to CHEN, Zhi; do not relabel them as an independent Huione address set. The October 2025 Huione measure is FinCEN section 311, not OFAC SDN designation.

name: ISIL KHORASAN
why_famous: OFAC added a large set of Tron and Monero identifiers that enabled a public comparison of designation and Tether freezing.
notes: Address-addition date, not original entity designation. The Recent Actions page links an unrelated Brazilian-network press release; no case-specific Treasury press release was found, so the press URL is intentionally blank. Monero identifiers remain untrackable on a public transaction ledger.

name: AL-JEBOURI, Zaid Issam Ahmed
why_famous: Treasury listed seven Tron identifiers under a named financial facilitator in a Hamas financing action.
notes: Use OFAC's named entry rather than assigning the addresses to every Hamas entity. Chainalysis's article date differs from the action date; its USD total and PublicAML's USDT-only total need reconciliation.
